_meta.what: Golden request/response schema fixture for the TypeSafe System One (Jev) API, captured from official vendor docs before any client code was written.
practitioner_errors_enforced: One-question-per-call: independent questions over the same state are sent TOGETHER in one request (they run in parallel); batching is enforced in the client by chunked Choice questions over a shared catalog.
Invented request fields: the request body is exactly {state, model, questions}; each question is exactly {type, instructions, criteria} with criteria shape per type. Nothing else is sent.

body.state: string | object | array (text only; no images/audio/video)
body.model: string — 'jev-latest' (alias) or versioned ID e.g. 'jev-1.13.0'; versioned IDs are accepted whether or not listed by GET /v1/models
body.questions: map<question_id, Question>; question_id chosen by caller, returned verbatim in answers; per docs the question id is not sent to the model

noul.instructions: string | object | array — the yes/no question
noul.criteria: optional object with 'true' and 'false' describing what yes/no mean

choice.criteria: map<option_key, string|object|array|null> — option rubric descriptions; MAXIMUM 255 OPTIONS PER CHOICE

score.criteria: ORDERED array of level descriptions; 2 to 10 levels

example_request.state: Help! My payouts have been failing for 3 days.

response.model: string — the VERSIONED id of the model that answered (e.g. 'jev-1.13.0'), even when an alias was sent
response.answers: map<question_id, Answer> — one per question, keyed by the ids sent

noul.noul: number 0..1 — probability of yes; NO separate confidence field (docs: 'no separate confidence')

choice.choice: string — one of the option keys defined in criteria

score.score: number — probability-weighted level; may land between integer levels

response.forward_compat: Unknown extra fields on responses are ignored (SDK docs); unknown answer kinds are skipped. The validator therefore checks required fields and rejects WRONG values but tolerates extra top-level/answer fields.

errors.401: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key (check Authorization header)
errors.422: Unprocessable Entity — request body failed validation; body details the offending field
errors.429: Too Many Requests — rate limit; back off and retry after a short delay
errors.529: Overloaded — retry after a short delay
errors.retry_policy: Docs: on 429/529 retry with exponential backoff. Client implements retry <=1 by default.

limits.rate_limit: 250,000 tokens per second / 1,200 requests per minute
